detail.longDescription: It seems my experiment running Snac2 as a Fediverse instance is coming to an end for now. It stopped loading posts after an update, but as I don't really use it might just have to sit in the dustbin for now. I appreciate it's simplicity but I don't think I'm ready to transition to it yet anyway. Gotosocial is solid enough. Perhaps someday though. # selfhosted # fediverse # snac2
